name: FLA_LEASES_INT
description: FLA_LEASES_INT contains the lease header and lease details information

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number which is either automatically generated or entered by the user, based on the system setup option.

columns.name: LEASE_NAME
columns.description: Lease name to identify the lease.

columns.name: LEASE_VERSION_NAME
columns.description: Lease version name, It is a short identifier of the version.

columns.name: LEASE_VERSION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Lease version description on what changes or amendments has been brought into the lease.

columns.name: LEASE_ASSET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the lease asset is of Equipment or Property type.

columns.name: LEASE_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the classification of the lease version. Possible values are Finance lease, Operating lease or Exempt Lease.

columns.name: EXECUTION_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the transaction is booked. It indicates the day on which the lease is being executed.

columns.name: LEASE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease is active. It is same as the lease commencement date for the first draft. It is not modifiable, once the lease is finalized.

columns.name: LEASE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease is inactive.

columns.name: CONTRACT_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease contract is active.

columns.name: CONTRACT_END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease contract is inactive.

columns.name: OPTION_LEVEL_ALLOWED_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if option is defined at asset or lease level.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the amortization has to be considered.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_END_DATE
columns.description: Date till the amortization has to be considered.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_PRORATION_CODE
columns.description: Proration method to identify the number of days to consider per month to prorate the amount

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Vendor identifier which represents the lessor associated with the lease.

columns.name: VENDOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Supplier name. Name of the supplier.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: Business unit to which the lease refers.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the lease contract.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the legal entity on the lease.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate which is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_DISC_RATE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Discount rate index that is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_DISC_RATE_IDX_NAME
columns.description: Discount rate index name that is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate which is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_DISC_RATE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Discount rate index that is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_DISC_RATE_IDX_NAME
columns.description: Discount rate index name that is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: MIGRATED_LEASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease is migrated from any exrernal system.

columns.name: TARGET_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The target status for the lease, whether to bring it in Draft, Completed or Active mode.

columns.name: MIGRATION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date when the lease was migrated in.

columns.name: ABSTRACTED_BY
columns.description: User name who has done the booking and can be different from CREATED_BY

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER
columns.description: Name of the user responsible for the lease creation.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the Import Job. Main Job Request ID.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for the lease if row is processed or rejected

columns.name: INCREASE_APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease can have payment increase agreements.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type which identifies which transaction is being executed. Various values could be BOOKING, TERMINATION and REVISION.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction sub type. Possible values are SCOPE_INCREASE, SCOPE_DECREASE, SCOPE_NO_CHANGE, EDIT and so forth for a REVISION transaction type.

columns.name: INCREASE_ACCOUNTING_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the contingent increase amount accounting treatment for the amendment. Possible value would be Contingent Increase and No Contingent Increase.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. This is referenced from FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: LEASE_AMENDMENT_NOTES
columns.description: Notes captured as part of the amendment.

columns.name: VERSION_PREPARED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has prepared the version.

columns.name: VERSION_SIGNED_DATE
columns.description: Date the version is signed on during an amendment.

columns.name: OPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Option type code which identifies which option is being chosen for exercise or cancelation.

columns.name: LEASE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the lease type. Valid values are EXPENSE, REVENUE and SUBLEASE.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill-to customer account number of the transaction.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases in primary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases in secondary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: LEASE_SECONDARY_CLASSIF_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the secondary classification of the lease. Possible values are Finance, Operating and Exempt.

columns.name: REQUIRE_PROPERTY_DEFN_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to Indicate if a property is required for the assets on the expense lease.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether lease is a sublease. This is applicable for a revenue lease.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier of the headlease. This is applicable if this lease is a sublease.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number of the headlease. This is applicable if this lease is a sublease.

columns.name: ENABLE_SUBLEASES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if subleases are allowed on this lease. This is applicable for an expense lease.

columns.name: INTEREST_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Interest method. Possible values are DAILY and PERIODIC COMPOUND.

columns.name: ARREARS_PAY_DT_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment due date is included in day count calculation for the present value derivation when the payment is in arrears. Possible values are Beginning of the day and End of the day.

columns.name: ROU_MIGRATION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Right of use migration basis. Indicates if the right of use balance should be entered as a gross or net amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
